title: Extended Abstract: Canonical join complex and cubical coordinates for all framing lattices
summary: This document is an extended abstract for two articles in preparation. Recently, framing lattices were introduced to generalize many classical lattices such as the Tamari lattice and the weak order on the symmetric group. We define bricks and brick cliques as a combinatorial model for join-irreducible elements and canonical join representations in all framing lattices, generalizing noncrossing arc diagrams of (Reading, 2015) for the weak order on the symmetric group. Our model captures the natural bijection between join and meet canonical representations, as well as duality upon reflections…
